text: Tell me about yourself.
alternatives: Walk me through the part of your background most relevant to this role.

text: Which part of your studies has been most useful in practical work?
alternatives: Tell me about a course concept you put into practice.

text: What technical skill are you currently trying to improve, and how are you practising it?
alternatives: Walk me through how you debug an unfamiliar technical problem.

text: How would you choose a baseline and evaluation metric for an ML problem?
Tell me about the project you are most proud of and the part you personally built.
alternatives: What problem did your strongest project address, and what was your responsibility?

text: What was the hardest design decision in that project, and why did you choose that approach?
How did you test that project and establish whether it solved the original problem?
Where could that project fail, and what would you improve next?
What did you personally deliver during your internship, and what feedback did you receive?
What have you applied from a certification or course you completed?
Why does this role interest you, and what experience supports that direction?
alternatives: Which responsibilities of this role fit your strengths and learning goals?

text: Based on the company information you have researched, what attracts you to this opportunity?
Where would you like to grow over the next three to five years?
alternatives: What would meaningful professional growth look like for you?

text: What strength would you bring to a team, and what experience demonstrates it?
Tell me about a disagreement in a team and how you handled it.
alternatives: Describe a time a teammate's perspective changed how you worked.

text: Tell me about a time you helped a group make a decision, even without a formal leadership role.
Tell me about an unfamiliar problem and how you decided what to try first.
alternatives: Describe a decision you made with incomplete information.

text: Tell me about something you tried that did not work and what you learned.
alternatives: Describe a mistake you made and how you responded.

text: Tell me about a time you had competing priorities and how you handled them.
alternatives: How did you handle a deadline that became difficult to meet?

text: Explain one idea from your studies to someone unfamiliar with your subject.
Tell me about feedback that changed how you approached your work.
How do you actually use AI tools in your work, if at all?
alternatives: What tasks would you trust an AI tool with, and where would you check its output?

text: You discover a release-blocking bug shortly before a deadline. How would you respond?
What would you do if you noticed a serious mistake in work already submitted?
Choose a skill on your resume. Where have you used it and what did you personally implement?
Tell me about a time you took ownership when something was not going as planned.
alternatives: Describe a time you took responsibility for an unfinished task.

text: Do you have any work-location or scheduling constraints relevant to this role?
What information would help you assess whether an offered package meets your expectations?
What factors would you consider before accepting an offer?
What interests outside coursework have helped you learn a useful skill?
How would you find out whether a product idea solves a real user's problem?
What achievement matters most to you, and what effort did it require?
What is one area you are still developing, and what are you doing about it?
Your preferred approach is unavailable and the deadline is unchanged. How would you adapt?
Do you have any questions for me?
